title: yadgarhq/chart
$comment: ADR-0847 (closed schemas; render checks own types) and ADR-0850 (closure is per chart). THE PARENT RENDERS NOTHING OF ITS OWN (this file's own docstring item 1 in scripts/tests/test_parent_chart.py), so this schema closes only two things: the root itself, and `global`, the one block this chart's own source (`chart/values.yaml`, README) declares a key under. Every other key an adopter might type belongs to a child chart, and ADR-0850 measured that a parent schema closing a child's section refuses that child's own default render before the child's own schema ever sees the values — so the nine sections below are each declared `{}`, an open object, and the typo inside one is THAT CHILD'S schema's refusal, not this file's (measured: `autoscaling.enabeld` is refused by the child; `autoscalng` at this root is refused here). `global` IS CLOSED, unlike a module chart's own copy of it (which stays open — ADR-0850 — because every OTHER subchart's keys may live there too): this repository is the one chart that actually DECLARES a key under `global` (`global.hostname`, ADR-0808), so `global.hostnmae` is a typo this schema can and does name, both at the schema layer and at `unrecognised_keys()`'s tarball-scoped check in the test suite (ledger 1153). The nine sections: `gateway`, `iam`, `iam-db`, `project`, `project-db`, `task`, `task-db` and `platform` are keys `chart/values.yaml` states; `config` is not — no module is wired to it today, no template reads it, and `chart/values.yaml` ships no default for it — but Helm hands every subchart's defaults through `global` and its own key to the SAME coalesced tree this schema validates, and a future `config` dependency (or an adopter pre-declaring values for one before it lands) must not refuse at this root before it ever reaches a child schema. Declaring it open here costs nothing today and avoids exactly the ADR-0850 failure mode this file exists to avoid.
